title: MSFS | RAAF Base Tindal is Massive! (YPTN Military Base Showcase)
description:
Exploring the northern territory of Australia to visit the newly updated RAAF Base Tindal (YPTN). This hybrid airport serves both civilian traffic at Katherine Tindal and a massive military operation.

In this video, we "sneak" into the military hangers to check out the custom-modeled support buildings, military trucks, and static fighter jets. I was honestly surprised by the scale of this base—it’s much larger than I expected! We also take a close look at the unique dual control towers and verify if you can spawn directly from the fighter ramps for your next F/A-18 Hornet mission.

What’s inside:

- Airport: RAAF Base Tindal / Katherine Tindal (YPTN)
- Highlights: Military aprons, custom hangers, and dual traffic towers.
- Tech Tip: I’m running this via streaming content (no manual downloads) to test the level of detail.

If you recognize the static fighter jets in the hangers, let me know the aircraft type in the comments!
